m1.typescript: m1 each course model gets the request it accepts

e1.typescript: e1 thinking modes a model does not have are refused

e2.typescript: e2 the mode that skips thinking up front is sonnet only and needs high effort or below

e3.typescript: e3 effort needs a supporting model and a real level

e4.typescript: e4 newer models reject sampling parameters and haiku keeps them

e5.typescript: e5 fast mode is opus only with its beta header and never in a batch

e6.typescript: e6 a manual budget is at least 1024 and below max tokens

e7.typescript: e7 effort lives in output config and never inside thinking

wrong-allow-disabled.defect: lets thinking be disabled on models that reject it

wrong-between-any-effort.defect: accepts between_tools at xhigh and max effort

wrong-effort-on-haiku.defect: sends effort to Haiku 4.5, which does not support it

wrong-sampling-pass-through.defect: passes temperature, top_p and top_k through to every model

wrong-fast-in-batch.defect: allows fast mode inside a batch

wrong-budget-floor.defect: accepts a budget below the 1,024 minimum

wrong-effort-in-thinking.defect: puts the effort level inside the thinking object

wrong-default-effort-omitted.defect: leaves output_config out when the effort equals the model's default
